title: Add ability to list the paths for GEMINI.md files in use
body:
### What would you like to be added?

I'd like the ability to know which GEMINI.md files are in used by hierarchical memory including their location. 

### Why is this needed?

This will be useful to troubleshot complex hierarchical memory situations as well as scenarios where the GEMINI.md files are not located in the project directory (e.g. long term memory in ~./.gemini).

### Additional context

_No response_
